title: Expected Payoff Identity
statement: Let $V$ and $D$ be finite sets, let each variable $v\in V$ have a probability law on $D$, and let $f:(V\to D)\to\mathbb{R}$ be a payoff. The expectation of $f$ under the independent product law of these variable laws equals the assignment’s expected payoff.
hypotheses_covered: A probability law on labels for each variable
